meaning: The instrument publisher's own English for the same numbered items. A parallel version rather than a translation of the administered string -- so where a local adaptation diverges from the original, this column stops corresponding word-for-word to the base field. Better wording, different provenance claim; that is why it is not merged with study_supplied.
This study's own deposit, supplement or paper carried an English rendering, and that is what ships.
No published English existed, so it was translated from the administered text by this project rather than by the authors. Requires an entry on the public issues page (ratified 2026-09-02).
Different fields came from different sources -- say which in the note.
No _translated columns: the study was administered in English, so there is nothing to translate.
The source states which response is correct -- an answer key in the codebook, deposit or paper. correct_response transcribes it.

No published key existed, so the correct answers were solved from the response data by this project rather than stated by the authors. Same class as machine_translation: it is IRW-generated content sitting in a content field, so it requires an entry on the public issues page (ratified 2026-09-03). Record in the note HOW it was derived and how well it reproduces, so a reader can judge it.
No correct_response, or the column is blank: the instrument has no correct answer (an attitude or frequency scale), so there is no key to source.
